source: Conservo il PC; distinguo notifica, scelta e conferma di consegna.
translation: Retain the PC; distinguish notification, choice and delivery confirmation.

source: Conservo il PC, poi ricevo il lavoro
translation: Retain the PC, then receive its work

source:
Tengo distinti pairing, presenza LAN e attivita' dell'ultimo prompt reale.
L'estensione EVENT porta avvisi e domande esplicite; non inventa una chat
quando manca un hook. Il contesto dichiarato e' un'etichetta.
translation: Keep pairing, LAN presence and activity from the last genuine prompt separate. The EVENT extension carries explicit notices and questions; it does not invent a chat when a hook is missing. The declared context is a label.

source:
Da Codex needs you apro due o tre scelte. La selezione apre un riepilogo con
Send e Back. Mostro Reply sent solo dopo l'ACK del destinatario. Una domanda
dura 180 secondi; la scadenza non sceglie al mio posto.
translation: Codex needs you opens two or three choices. Selecting one opens a summary with Send and Back. Reply sent appears only after the recipient's ACK. A question lasts 180 seconds; expiry never chooses for the user.

source: Le PR restano in sola lettura

Conservo la decisione A03: gli screen 21-24 riportano stati e nomi dei check
falliti. Il 25 e' ritirato; diagnosi e azioni PR restano sul PC. Un'approvazione nativa
rimanda a On your PC, senza Allow o Deny su Cody.
translation: Keep decision A03: screens 21-24 show states and failed check names. Screen 25 is retired; PR diagnosis and actions remain on the PC. Native approvals point to On your PC, with no Allow or Deny on Cody.

source:
Ho aggiornato pagine principali e limiti del flow. Conservo gli addenda
precedenti e aggiungo errata datate. Distinguo il contratto nei sorgenti dalle
prove host e fisiche; registro gli esiti correnti in done.md.
translation: The main pages and flow limits have been updated. Earlier addenda are preserved and dated errata added. Source contracts, host evidence and physical evidence remain distinct; current outcomes are recorded in done.md.

source: Prima scopro Cody; poi uso solo il codice visibile sul dispositivo.
translation: Discover Cody first; then use only the code visible on the device.

source:
Con CCP attivo chiedo di scoprire Cody e associarlo con il codice attuale. Uso il
dispositivo fisico come fonte, senza recuperare vecchi codici da immagini o
documenti.
translation: With CCP active, ask to discover Cody and pair it using the current code. The physical device is the source; never retrieve old codes from images or documents.

source:
Il codice deve corrispondere a una sola offerta corrente. Con nessuna o piu'
corrispondenze tengo l'errore esplicito. Non scelgo chi risponde per primo.
translation: The code must match exactly one current offer. With zero or multiple matches, keep the error explicit. Never choose whichever responds first.

source:
Lascio aperta la schermata del codice. Una richiesta ammessa non e' ancora
pairing concluso: attendo salvataggio e conferma su entrambi i lati.
translation: Keep the code screen open. An admitted request is not completed pairing: wait for storage and confirmation on both sides.

source:
Seguo automaticamente la chat dell'ultimo prompt reale. Se vedo Waiting for
Codex controllo hook ed esecuzione locale; cambiare pairing non crea eventi.
translation: Automatically follow the chat of the last genuine prompt. If Waiting for Codex appears, check hooks and local execution; changing pairing does not create events.

source: Screen 15, 26 e 27 / l'etichetta context non e' l'identita' della chat.
translation: Screens 15, 26 and 27 / the context label is not chat identity.

source:
Ricevo una domanda dal chiamante MCP esplicito; per gli avvisi mostro From
Codex. Leggo testo inglese ASCII. Il contesto e' dichiarato dal chiamante, senza
attribuirgli l'identita' verificata della chat o degli hook.
translation: Receive a question from the explicit MCP caller; notices show From Codex. Read English ASCII text. The caller declares context, without claiming verified chat or hook identity.

source:
Con Open leggo le due o tre risposte e le rispettive descrizioni. Conservo una
sola domanda aperta per dispositivo. Attivita', notifiche successive e indicatori
batteria non la sostituiscono.
translation: Open shows two or three answers and their descriptions. Keep one open question per device. Activity, later notices and battery indicators cannot replace it.

source:
Un PermissionRequest puo' richiamare la mia attenzione, ma la decisione nativa
resta nel computer. Non aggiungo Allow, Deny o un'autorizzazione generica
ricavata da un testo incompleto.
translation: PermissionRequest can draw attention, but the native decision remains on the computer. Do not add Allow, Deny or generic authorization inferred from incomplete text.
A notice is not an answer

source:
Una notifica non offre scelte e non produce REPLY. Riservo Reply sent alle
risposte consegnate. Per le PR ammetto soltanto gli stati e la lista read-only
previsti da A03; nessuna azione operativa.
translation: A notification offers no choices and produces no REPLY. Reply sent is reserved for delivered answers. PRs admit only the states and read-only list defined by A03; no operational actions.

source: Screen 26/27, 32 e 35A/35B / conservo il percorso e rispetto la scadenza.
translation: Screens 26/27, 32 and 35A/35B / preserve the route and respect expiry.

source:
Una domanda aperta resta davanti agli aggiornamenti ordinari. Conservo
selezione e percorso. Batteria, charging o un avviso successivo non fanno sparire
una decisione che devo ancora leggere.
translation: An open question takes priority over ordinary updates. Preserve selection and route. Battery, charging or a later notice cannot remove a decision the user still needs to read.

source:
Conservo il contenuto e cerco il PC salvato. La scadenza continua: tornare sulla
LAN non rinnova i 180 secondi. Timeout, Cancel e disconnessione non scelgono
un'opzione e non confermano consegna.
translation: Keep the content and search for the saved PC. Expiry continues: returning to the LAN never renews the 180 seconds. Timeout, Cancel and disconnection neither choose an option nor confirm delivery.

source:
Prima di Send mostro Request expired; dopo Send, Reply unconfirmed e Check
on your PC. Uso Request cancelled o Reply rejected per gli altri esiti, con Done.
Non riapro stati terminali.
translation: Before Send, show Request expired; after Send, Reply unconfirmed and Check on your PC. Use Request cancelled or Reply rejected for other outcomes, with Done. Terminal states never reopen.

source:
Mantengo Wi-Fi durante lo standby di Cody associato. Accodo il wake per un
avviso autenticato al worker power, preservando AFE e wake word. Registro a
parte gli esiti del risveglio fisico.
translation: Keep Wi-Fi during paired Cody standby. Queue wake for an authenticated notice to the power worker, preserving AFE and wake word. Record physical wake outcomes separately.

source: Screen 31 / il destinatario MCP deve riconoscere la ricezione.
translation: Screen 31 / the MCP recipient must acknowledge receipt.

source:
Il chiamante MCP crea un ticket di 128 bit con capability privata. Poll e cancel
richiedono entrambi i valori. La capability resta sul PC e non viaggia sulla LAN.
translation: The MCP caller creates a 128-bit ticket with a private capability. Poll and cancel require both values. The capability stays on the PC and never travels over the LAN.

source:
Il poll restituisce scelta e answer_id. Un poll successivo con
acknowledge_answer_id uguale prova la ricezione del chiamante: solo allora
passo a delivered e allo screen 31.
translation: Polling returns the choice and answer_id. A later poll with matching acknowledge_answer_id proves caller receipt: only then does the state become delivered and open screen 31.

source:
Dopo pending entro in Sending locale, senza cambiare scelta. Received non e'
ancora delivered. Ripetere la stessa risposta e' idempotente; una diversa non
sovrascrive la prima.
translation: After pending, enter local Sending without changing the choice. Received is not yet delivered. Repeating the same answer is idempotent; a different answer never overwrites the first.

source:
I 180 secondi valgono anche in received. Se ho gia' ammesso Send mostro Reply
unconfirmed: puo' mancare solo l'ACK. Prima di Send uso Request expired.
Nessun Retry o ACK tardivo riapre la domanda.
translation: The 180-second limit also applies in received. If Send was already admitted, show Reply unconfirmed: only the ACK may be missing. Before Send, use Request expired. Neither Retry nor a late ACK reopens the question.

source:
The initial analysis omitted startup with Wi-Fi already configured but no saved Codex pairing, and did not define a reversible user entry to setup. This was an
original analysis gap (buco di analisi iniziale), now addressed in source.
translation:
The initial analysis omitted startup with Wi-Fi already configured but no saved Codex pairing, and did not define a reversible user entry to setup. This was an
original analysis gap, now addressed in source.

source:
The first analysis did not reconcile the legacy Welcome timeout/touch path with reopening setup after standby. This was an original analysis gap (buco di analisi
iniziale).
translation: The first analysis did not reconcile the legacy Welcome timeout/touch path with reopening setup after standby. This was an original analysis gap.

source:
The initial analysis omitted Options re-entry and did not distinguish an optional malformed runtime touch report from renderer failure. This was a buco di analisi
iniziale. Options now opens 10 and returns to Setup after preferences/skin.
translation: The initial analysis omitted Options re-entry and did not distinguish an optional malformed runtime touch report from renderer failure. This was an initial analysis gap. Options now opens 10 and returns to Setup after preferences/skin.

source:
Screen 15 originally proved PC presence only. The initial analysis omitted explicit chat selection, shared runtime lifetime and event freshness. This was a buco di
analisi iniziale; it is now addressed in source.
translation: Screen 15 originally proved PC presence only. The initial analysis omitted explicit chat selection, shared runtime lifetime and event freshness. This was an initial analysis gap; it is now addressed in source.

source: Registro della decisione / 10 ottobre 2026 / screen 04-16, 35B, 36 e 40-42.

Senza Wi-Fi salvato apro 04-09. Con credenziali ma senza IP uso 42. Con LAN e
senza pairing offro 40. Con un record valido riprendo 14-15, senza verificare
Internet.
translation: Without saved Wi-Fi, open 04-09. With credentials but no IP, use 42. With LAN and no pairing, offer 40. With a valid record, resume 14-15 without checking the Internet.

source:
Apro 41 tenendo premuto il personaggio per 1,5 secondi. Con un pairing salvato
mostro Already paired: Keep pairing, Pair again oppure Forget. Retry riprende la
ricerca senza codice nuovo.
translation: Open 41 by holding the character for 1.5 seconds. With saved pairing, show Already paired: Keep pairing, Pair again or Forget. Retry resumes discovery without a new code.

source:
Con 13 confermo il pairing. Let's go cerca subito il PC. Su 15 confermo CCP e
attendo il prompt reale. Gli hook seguono la sua chat automaticamente: ho
eliminato la scelta manuale.
translation: Screen 13 confirms pairing. Let's go immediately searches for the PC. Screen 15 confirms CCP and waits for a genuine prompt. Hooks follow its chat automatically; manual selection has been removed.

source:
Apro Make it yours da Options e riutilizzo Settings e Skin. Torno al chiamante
corretto. Tengo separati preferenze, sostituzione del PC e qualsiasi cancellazione
esplicita.
translation: Open Make it yours from Options and reuse Settings and Skin. Return to the correct caller. Keep preferences, PC replacement and any explicit deletion separate.

Screens 14-16, 18U, 32, 35A/35B and 42 / retain the saved identity.

source:
Continuo a usare il collegamento Wi-Fi/IP locale tra Cody e CCP. Tengo separata
la disponibilita' dei servizi online di Codex: il PC presente sulla LAN non mi
garantisce una risposta del modello.
translation: Continue using the local Wi-Fi/IP link between Cody and CCP. Codex online service availability is separate: PC presence on the LAN does not guarantee a model response.

source:
Conservo credenziali e PC associato. All'avvio mostro 42 con Network setup o
Later. Durante il recupero attendo la LAN e riprovo con l'identita' salvata. Gli
errori reali del trasporto restano visibili nello stato.
translation: Retain credentials and the paired PC. At startup, show 42 with Network setup or Later. During recovery, wait for the LAN and retry using the saved identity. Real transport errors remain visible in state.

source:
Continuo la ricerca su 14; uso 32 per la perdita dopo un'attivita' gia' seguita.
Retry riprende la ricerca senza nuovo codice. Posso comunque tenere premuto
Cody per 1,5 secondi e aprire Setup.
translation: Continue discovery on 14; use 32 for loss after tracked activity. Retry resumes discovery without a new code. Holding Cody for 1.5 seconds can still open Setup.

source:
Con lo standby ordinario conservo percorso e pairing. Al risveglio recupero la
presenza autenticata. Un flash applicativo normale preserva NVS; cancellazione,
dati danneggiati o altra identita' PC sono casi distinti.
translation: Ordinary standby preserves route and pairing. Wake restores authenticated presence. A normal application flash preserves NVS; erasure, damaged data or a different PC identity are distinct cases.

source: Screen 12, 13, 40 e 41 / conservo rete, skin, preferenze e log.
translation: Screens 12, 13, 40 and 41 / keep network, skin, settings and logs.

source:
Sul PC salvo il candidato DPAPI prima di PAIR; sul Cody uso ccp_pending. Tengo
separati i vecchi attivi. CONFIRM oppure READY fresco provano il PC e
consentono commit e rilettura sul Cody.
translation: On the PC, save the DPAPI candidate before PAIR; Cody uses ccp_pending. Keep previous active records separate. CONFIRM or fresh READY proves the PC and permits commit and readback on Cody.

source: Chiudo con una prova del commit

Il PC promuove dopo ACTIVE o COMMITTED autenticati, mai per il solo FIND.
Dopo ogni READY valido Cody ripete COMMITTED con il nonce corrente:
recupero riavvii e ACK persi senza un altro codice.
translation: The PC promotes after authenticated ACTIVE or COMMITTED, never FIND alone. After each valid READY, Cody repeats COMMITTED with the current nonce, recovering restarts and lost ACKs without a new code.

source:
Dal codice pronto scarto il candidato Cody. Conservo il vecchio link operativo;
sul PC il candidato resta pending. Per sostituirlo richiedo nuovo codice e
replace_pending:true esplicito. Una prova con la vecchia chiave non autorizza la
cancellazione.
translation: Once the code is ready, discard Cody's candidate. Keep the previous link operational; the PC candidate stays pending. Replacement requires a new code and explicit replace_pending:true. Proof using the old key does not authorize deletion.

source:
Confermo Forget pairing con Go back / Forget e Only Codex is reset. Cancello
solo i record CCP di Cody; il PC conserva il suo. Dopo l'esito reale mostro
Unpaired / Pairing removed, poi Done -> Setup.
translation: Confirm Forget pairing with Go back / Forget and Only Codex is reset. Delete only Cody's CCP records; the PC keeps its record. After the real outcome, show Unpaired / Pairing removed, then Done -> Setup.

source:
Ho integrato il flow corrente nelle pagine principali, conservando quelle non
coinvolte e tutti gli addenda/errata precedenti. Riferisco il percorso agli screen ID
anche quando cambia la paginazione.
translation: The current flow is integrated into the main pages, preserving unrelated pages and all earlier addenda/errata. Routes refer to screen IDs even when pagination changes.

source:
Options salva quattro preferenze; Already paired offre Keep pairing, Pair again e
Forget. Separo Retry, Cancel e reset. Uso journal separati e COMMITTED per il
commit reale. Let's go cerca subito.
translation: Options saves four preferences; Already paired offers Keep pairing, Pair again and Forget. Retry, Cancel and reset are separate. Separate journals and COMMITTED prove the real commit. Let's go searches immediately.

source: Buco di analisi iniziale e responsabilita'

Avevo mescolato commissioning, recupero e attivita', senza chiedere conferma
della sostituzione. Ho esplicitato queste decisioni. CCP segue il prompt
autentico; ho ritirato la vecchia scelta manuale della chat.
translation: Commissioning, recovery and activity were conflated without confirming replacement. These decisions are now explicit. CCP follows the genuine prompt; the former manual chat choice is retired.

source:
Conservo il linguaggio approvato: gradienti, icone, coppia orizzontale o capsula
singola e pulsanti senza teletype. Con questa revisione aggiorno sorgenti e
documenti; elenco separatamente le prove di dispositivo, hook e simulatore
ancora da completare.
translation: Keep the approved language: gradients, icons, a horizontal pair or single capsule, and buttons without teletype. This revision updates source and documents; device, hook and simulator checks still required are listed separately.

source:
Mostro il contesto dichiarato, il titolo e l'avviso. La richiesta ha un ticket distinto e
dura 180 secondi. Aprire o chiudere una vista non allunga la scadenza e non
seleziona una risposta.
translation: Show the declared context, title and notice. The request has its own ticket and lasts 180 seconds. Opening or closing a view never extends expiry or selects an answer.

source:
Uso due card affiancate; con tre aggiungo quella centrata sotto. Ogni scelta ha
un ID stabile e un significato proprio. Back torna a 26 e conserva la domanda,
senza inviare.
translation: Use two cards side by side; with three, add one centered below. Each choice has a stable ID and its own meaning. Back returns to 26 and keeps the question without sending.

source:
La scelta apre un riepilogo con descrizione e capsula Send. Back mi riporta alle
opzioni. Dopo Send tengo la scelta ferma e mostro Sending reply. Non aggiungo
un quarto pulsante sotto tre card.
translation: A choice opens a summary with a description and Send capsule. Back returns to the options. After Send, keep the choice fixed and show Sending reply. Do not add a fourth button below three cards.

source:
L'ACK UDP received lascia Waiting for Codex: CCP ha registrato la scelta. Solo
con delivered mostro Reply sent e Delivered to Codex; Done riprende il contesto
precedente 17, 18 o 16.
translation: The received UDP ACK leaves Waiting for Codex: CCP recorded the choice. Only delivered shows Reply sent and Delivered to Codex; Done resumes previous context 17, 18 or 16.

source: A03 resta in vigore / screen 21-24; 25 ritirato.
translation: A03 remains in force / screens 21-24; 25 retired.

source:
Osservo soltanto il PR indicato. Conservo l'esatto head dello snapshot esplicito
fornito da Codex. Non uso Stop come prova dei check e non offro merge,
approve, close, rerun o comment.
translation: Observe only the specified PR. Keep the exact head from the explicit snapshot supplied by Codex. Stop is not check evidence; no merge, approve, close, rerun or comment actions are offered.

source:
Mostro numeri solo da un elenco completo e attuale sullo stesso head. Checks
passed non ha pulsanti: attendo la fine della narrativa e tre secondi, poi torno al
lavoro.
translation: Show counts only from a complete current list on the same head. Checks passed has no buttons: wait until the narrative finishes, then three seconds, before returning to work.

source:
L'unica azione apre i nomi reali dei check falliti: al massimo sei, fino a 48 caratteri
ASCII ciascuno. Un input non rappresentabile viene rifiutato esplicitamente; non
taglio nomi e non invento totali.
translation: The sole action opens actual failed check names: at most six, each up to 48 ASCII characters. Reject unrepresentable input explicitly; never truncate names or invent totals.

source:
Mostro tre nomi per pagina, fino a due righe ciascuno; scorro verticalmente e
tengo Back laterale. Non offro View log o righe selezionabili. Log, diagnosi e
correzioni restano sul PC.
translation: Show three names per page, up to two lines each; scroll vertically and keep lateral Back. No View log or selectable rows. Logs, diagnosis and corrections stay on the PC.

source:

acknowledge_answer_id uguale prova la ricezione del chiamante: solo allora

translation: Polling returns the choice and answer_id. A later poll with matching acknowledge_answer_id proves caller receipt: only then does the state become delivered and open screen 31.

source:
I 180 secondi valgono anche in received. Se ho gia' ammesso Send mostro Reply
unconfirmed: puo' mancare solo l'ACK. Prima di Send uso Request expired.
Nessun Retry o ACK tardivo riapre la domanda.
translation: The 180-second limit also applies in received. If Send was already admitted, show Reply unconfirmed: only the ACK may be missing. Before Send, use Request expired. Neither Retry nor a late ACK reopens the question.

source:
Scrivo 'resetta il device codice 043533477' nel messaggio corrente: nove cifre,
zero compreso. E' un controllo anti-equivoco, non una password; non lo
completo dai documenti. Uso il peer paired LAN, dati conservati. ACK =
accepted; boot = nuova presenza.
translation: Write 'restart the device code 043533477' in the current message: nine digits, including zero. This prevents ambiguity; it is not a password and must not be completed from documents. Use the paired LAN peer and preserve data. ACK = accepted; boot = fresh presence.

source:
Con 'formatta cody 043533477' elimino preferenze, Wi-Fi e pairing; conservo
firmware, asset e SD. ACK indica ammissione. Riavvio solo dopo cancellazione
verificata; poi riparto dal setup Wi-Fi. Un errore resta visibile e non avvia il
reboot.
translation: With 'format cody 043533477', erase preferences, Wi-Fi and pairing; keep firmware, assets and SD. ACK means admission. Restart only after verified erasure, then return to Wi-Fi setup. An error stays visible and prevents reboot.

translation: Affected main pages are updated, preserving unrelated flow pages and earlier addenda. References use screen IDs.

source:
Ho applicato A03: PR in sola lettura e 25 ritirato. Ho rimosso View log e il vecchio
elenco verticale. Ora 27 ha card e riepilogo Send; 31 richiede delivered dopo
l'ACK del destinatario.
translation: Apply A03: read-only PRs and retired screen 25. Remove View log and the old vertical list. Screen 27 now has cards and a Send summary; 31 requires delivered after the recipient's ACK.

source:
Avevo lasciato ambigui ricevuta, consegna e scadenza, oltre a illustrazioni PR
superate. Li separo con ticket, received/delivered e 180 secondi. Timeout e
offline non scelgono risposte.
translation: Receipt, delivery and expiry were ambiguous, alongside outdated PR illustrations. Tickets, received/delivered and the 180-second limit now separate them. Timeout and offline never select answers.

source:
Ho separato riavvio e factory reset: il primo conserva i dati, il secondo cancella la
configurazione per tornare al setup. ACK indica ammissione. Conservo storico ed
errori reali; gli esiti host e fisici sono in done.md.
translation: Restart and factory reset are separate: restart preserves data; reset clears configuration and returns to setup. ACK means admission. Preserve history and real errors; host and physical outcomes are in done.md.
